title: Looking for backlink partners: fair, relevant backlink exchange ( real sites only)
author: tradematesHQ
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I run TradeMates (trademates.co) – free in-depth stock analyses – and I'm looking for other trading, investing or crypto sites to exchange links with.

How I'd do it:

\- Drop your site + rough traffic/DR in the comments or DM me

\- We each add a link inside a relevant article (no footer/sidebar stuff)

\- Both live within a week, we send each other the URL

\- Links stay up for at least 12 months

Only real sites with own content, no PBNs. Interested? Comment or DM.

If you're interested, just comment below or send me a DM, and let's help each other rank. 🚀

comments.author: myaboutpage
comments.body: Add your website to my directory https://indexyour.link

comments.body:
Hey, I run [MeSIM](https://mesim.io/) — a travel eSIM marketplace with 7,000+ plans across 200+ destinations.

Launched a few weeks ago and currently getting around 250 organic visitors a day. I'm actively building backlinks and partnerships to grow our SEO.

Different niche, but there could be some relevant crossover with international travel, digital nomads and staying connected while trading overseas.

Happy to explore a natural contextual backlink exchange if there's a good fit!
